lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 7-8 visible vertical white stripes; spacing is relatively uniform in the mid-torso but wider between the first and second anterior stripes.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The anterior-most stripe and the two posterior-most stripes exhibit abbreviated lengths, terminating mid-torso without reaching the dorsal ridge or ventral line.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Two distinct, high-contrast white circular spots located on the lateral-posterior haunch in a vertical-diagonal orientation.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Lyrate trajectory; horns emerge with a posterior-lateral vector, curving outward before spiraling medially toward the terminal tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The distance between the terminal horn tips is approximately 2.8 times the pixel width of a single basal segment.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The top 10-12% of the total horn length consists of high-contrast ivory-colored tips, distinct from the dark, annulated lower segments.

other_distinctive_markers: Two white facial spots on the cheek; high-contrast white dorsal crest extending to the tail; multi-tonal limbs featuring tan-orange upper sections and white distal socks.
